verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official W&B CLI documented at docs.wandb.ai/models/ref/cli, so the vendor ships a first-party CLI. However, it sits under the W&B Models reference, and nothing in the pack shows it covering Weave traces, evaluations, or scorers or being built for agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of Weave-specific CLI commands, documentation of CLI use in AI-native/agentic workflows, hands-on or independent corroboration.
